run_shard_docs: run the shard_docs script to split a large document file into N shards respecting document boundaries
run_shard_docs_num_shards: run the shard_docs script with --num-shards to split a file into a specific number of output shards
review_main: review the main function that parses input file and num-shards arguments to shard documents by empty-line boundaries
review_output_doc: review the output_doc nested function that writes accumulated document lines to the correct shard output file
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support configurable document boundary separators beyond empty lines
